dependence_model.name: comonotonic_shared_severity_rank
dependence_model.definition: For every occurrence i, X_i=Q_i(U), where U~Uniform(0,1) is global and shared across the portfolio and Q_i is a nondecreasing generalized-inverse marginal quantile function. Only ranks p in {0.5,0.9} are evaluated.
dependence_model.reviewer_effort_coupling: Reviewer-effort P50 entries use the same global shared-rank planning model; only their additive P50 is reported.

interpretation: At the two declared ranks, the aggregate P50 and P90 are tail-aligned additive planning quantiles under the declared comonotonic model.
They are not distribution-free bounds, confidence intervals, elapsed-calendar forecasts, or evidence of ticket independence.
The two supplied ranks do not identify a complete marginal distribution between or beyond P50 and P90.
Parallel execution changes elapsed time but does not discount accountable effort.

arithmetic.rounding: none after authoring; day priors are converted at exactly 8 hours/day
